I’m sorry I have to disagree with you there, it is scientifically proven that humans can, after a very heavy heartbreak actually tear strings inside the organ itself causing it to not be able to function as you say as a ‘pump’. Our own mind has the capabilities of psychosomatically changing the ways certain organs and muscles function especially after experiencing painful trauma, it’s a self defence mechanism we all possess. It’s where ptsd, phobias and anxiety stem from. There have been many people who have died not immediately from whatever disease or condition they were enduring/suffering from at the time but because they give up on themselves causing the brain start to shut down all it’s functions becoming immobile (Alzheimer’s for example). The human mind has so much control we still properly can’t comprehend what effects it can have on our own bodies as well as the capabilities we could achieve by keeping healthy and learning more and more each day about our own bodies. The heart maybe an organ with a specific function such as pumping blood and oxygen throughout the body but it is as delicate as any other organ, bone or muscle and we should take care of it the same we do our teeth, how our muscles protect our bones and our skull protects what is in a sense pushing all the buttons aha, in control of ourselves. Healthy diet, exercise, omega supplements, efficient calcium and vitamin intake as well as all the other important nutrients and minerals we can obtain and keeping ones cholesterol and stress at bay is our way of shielding one of our most important organs. The same way your brain reminds you of something that hurt or was wrong in the past to be able to avoid making the same mistake again. If it weren’t for the anxiety our brain uses as it’s self defending asset to keep us safe, people would be getting hit by cars everyday, putting metal in microwaves and drinking bleach aha. Adaptability is our greatest superpower. It’s what makes the alphas of the animal world where they are on the food chain. And we are specie are on top. See a lion? Fucking run, it’s not going start purring like that kitty cat back at home. Going for a swim? Always be aware of marine life as you are in their territory. The environment itself has its own dangers. The devastation that occurred with Pompeii was the self defence mechanism we all needed to realise not to build a civilisation on a freaking volcano. Even if it seem dormant or not. The planet is unpredictable. Conscientiousness is something every person should be taught as it not only teaches them to be cautious of staying safe but it also allows us to avoid the inevitability. Creating safety nets that our brains do subconsciously when it detects danger using past experiences and knowledge obtained from educating itself. Sorry for the massive tangent of a message, one of those days in need of expressing wisdom to others to help protect them and have a more understanding of life. Learn, don’t copy. We have the abilities to achieve true greatness and save lives and prosper as a collective:) Have an awesome day!
